authorization: User selected GPAW and authorized installation, PE energy/force/stress validation, then convergence tests; all data/logs retained.
datasets: One common native GPAW PBE PAW C/H pair; archive files, version, origin and SHA256 before production.

geometry.description: Tashiro 1997 refined C4H8 orthorhombic PE, a=7.432 b=4.929 c=2.545 Angstrom; hydrogen coordinates constrained in the original refinement.

technical_validation.stage_1: Finite, converged single-point energy, all atomic forces and six stress components for all three methods, with DFT and additive dispersion components separately retained.
technical_validation.stage_2: Analytic forces and stress compared to energy finite differences at two step sizes. Integer G-vector set and grid changes are diagnostics, not silently ignored.
technical_validation.strain_revision_reason: Small strains reduce PW basis-shell crossings; GPAW stress test reference-generation branch uses 1e-5. Original larger-step plan retained in protocol_revision01.json. Thresholds unchanged; actual G sets and grids compared; tighten SCF and test residual noise.
technical_validation.force_coverage: Three nonzero representative components: C atom0 x, H(A) atom4 y, H(B) atom8 z; not all 36 components.
technical_validation.technical_probe_revision_reason: 600 eV crosses density PW shells under the prescribed small strains. 600.012 eV was selected by geometry-only descriptor checks with no energy-based selection; all wavefunction/density G sets invariant across 25 center/strain geometries. This is not a production cutoff recommendation. Higher grid and XC stencil address gradient discretization, with optB88 yz error reduced from 0.438 to 0.00392 kbar in controlled diagnostics.
technical_validation.stress_coverage: All six independent components on a deliberately perturbed/sheared PE probe.
technical_validation.status_policy: A smoke test alone cannot be labeled derivative validation. State representative force coverage explicitly.

numerical_convergence.reference: Highest tested point only becomes a reference after a plateau is confirmed; extend if needed.
additional_checks: optimized cell comparison at accepted and higher precision
numerical_convergence.cell_optimization_method: PBE-D3(BJ), unless actual validation requires a documented revision

extended_scan_revision.reason: Energy and stress not stable through1200 eV. Separate dense-grid cutoff series is required before extension above the grid64 density cap.
extended_scan_revision.density_cutoff_coupling: Native GPAW PW changes density pd2 along with wavefunction ecut; density pd2 nominally2E and pd3 nominally8E, both subject to grid representation.
extended_scan_revision.later_grid_scan: Choose grids that do not truncate required density cutoff at the accepted ecut, then test further refinement.

numerical_convergence.optimized_geometry_cold_start_check: At both accepted optimization endpoints, repeat a cold-start single point using the same high-precision setting and audit raw forces and stresses.

deviations_from_original.change: Quantum ESPRESSO to GPAW, native PBE PAW datasets instead of SSSP UPF.
deviations_from_original.reason: Retain PAW while supporting the selected meta-GGA and vdW methods.
deviations_from_original.impact: Not an SSSP-certified calculation. Dataset/basis implementation changes may change absolute energies and forces. Re-establish convergence; compare relative energies within a fixed method and dataset.

deviations_from_original.change: Cutoff is entered in eV; initial scan 400-800 eV with extensions if needed, not copied from QE Ry values.
deviations_from_original.reason: GPAW native PAW datasets have different basis requirements.
deviations_from_original.impact: Nominal cutoff values across codes are not an accuracy equivalence. Final settings determined by measured energy/force/stress changes.

deviations_from_original.change: PBE-D3(BJ) and r2SCAN-D4 use explicitly parameterized additive dispersion libraries; optB88-vdW uses libvdwxc 0.5 with stress.
deviations_from_original.reason: Make energy, force and stress contributions traceable.
deviations_from_original.impact: Damping, ATM three-body terms, periodic cutoffs and library versions are part of the method and must be locked.

deviations_from_original.change: CPU and legacy GPAW PW implementation used first.
deviations_from_original.reason: Prioritize a single implementation with validated support for all requested properties.
deviations_from_original.impact: Runtime may increase relative to GPU execution; this is not an accuracy downgrade.

deviations_from_original.change: PBE numerical scan followed by method-specific checks, rather than assuming one scan proves every functional.
deviations_from_original.reason: Meta-GGA and nonlocal vdW may have distinct grid and stress sensitivity.
deviations_from_original.impact: Additional calculations; avoids incorrectly transferring numerical convergence.

deviations_from_original.change: Lock a versioned validated scope rather than an unconditional never-change setting.
deviations_from_original.reason: New elements, altered cells and failed transfer checks may require revalidation.
deviations_from_original.impact: Preserves reproducibility without claiming numerical or dataset errors vanish.

retention: Preserve inputs, exact structures, software and PAW provenance, complete stdout/stderr, SCF iteration energies, converged energy/force/stress components, checkpoints, failed calculations and every protocol revision.

dispersion_settings_revision02.reason: Reduce periodic cutoff-boundary discontinuities in force/stress finite differences; pilot hard-cutoff runs retained. Revision03 extends D3 CN from40 to60 Bohr after independent cutoff/derivative checks. Method audit quantifies the changes.

lock: None yet. Only lock settings supported by completed measurements.
